title: Some links before titles cannot be clicked anymore
body:
On https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/widgets/CurrentRefinements.html you cannot click on view in storybook, there's a big ::after rule that is blocking this.

CC @mikaa123 it's back :) Maybe you can pair with @LukyVj to solve this. Luckily there's now auto deployment of PRS so we can triple check before merging.

Thanks

* \[x] links should work
* \[x] anchors should scroll at the right position
